title: Carrier Study: RTD Delivery Systems
summary: Oway is an industrial intelligence company automating LTL distribution. Ship 1 to 12+ pallets for up to 50% lower cost using our AI-native engine. Get an instant quote and a vehicle at your facility in as little as 30 minutes.
body_markdown:
###### **RTD Delivery Systems, a trusted regional carrier operating since 2005, faced growing challenges in a tightening freight market. With stagnant broker rates, underutilized capacity, and increased operational pressures, they sought a way to boost profitability without adding complexity to their workflow.**


‍


###### **The Challenge**


RTD Delivery Systems had long operated with brokers like STG and T Force, whose rates hadn’t kept pace with market realities. Despite consistently running their most popular lanes at 75–80% capacity, RTD often faced inefficiencies — with some routes operating half-full. To make up for this underutilization, the team relied on time-consuming cold outreach and manual broker coordination to backfill empty space, pulling resources away from growth and creating operational drag.


###### **Working With Oway**


Oway helps carriers unlock incremental revenue by seamlessly filling unused space on their existing routes — no detours, no drama. For RTD, this meant smarter load matching that filled empty capacity without altering routes, and a fully automated booking experience: **just click an email, review the load, and accept in seconds. No calls, no negotiations, and no surprises at pickup or delivery — just efficient, frictionless freight.**


‍


###### **The Results**


In just one week, RTD generated an additional $1,520 in revenue from only five shipments — all by leveraging unused space on their existing routes. With Oway’s instant booking system, loads were secured in seconds, dramatically improving operational efficiency


**95% of pickups and drop-offs were completed in under 10 minutes, with a seamless, no-hassle-experience on every shipment.**


For RTD, Oway is noted for being faster and easier than any platform they had used before.


> “It’s crazy out there. We don’t know how some carriers are surviving. Oway helped us fill empty space and earn extra income with virtually no extra effort. Just click and go.”
> — RTD Delivery Systems Inc.


‍


###### **Conclusion**


RTD Delivery Systems didn’t need a new dispatch team or a complicated tech stack — they just needed a better way to move freight. Partnering with Oway gave them exactly that: **effortless profit from underutilized space, automated booking that cut out the back-and-forth, and a tool built for the realities of modern logistics.** In a market defined by volatility and razor-thin margins, Oway helped RTD operate leaner, move faster, and earn more — without changing a thing about how they run.
